panels.title: Big questions
points: A farmer's fertiliser can kill fish in a river a kilometre away. Trace the chain of events.

keywords.def: excess nutrients cause algal growth, oxygen depletion and death of aquatic life
absorbs infrared radiation: water vapour, CO₂, methane, nitrous oxide, CFCs
rain made acidic by SO₂ and nitrogen oxides
toxic gas that binds to haemoglobin

panels.title: Revision: B4 human impact, then a timed B3 to B5 section
points: SO₂: acid rain, damages leaves, kills organisms in lakes
CO: reduces oxygen carried by blood
Human activity: burning fuels (CO₂), cattle and rice (methane), fertilisers (N₂O)
